verdict.rationale: Angular components bundle template (HTML), styles (CSS), and class logic (TypeScript/JS) together, and community reports confirm components are encapsulated and reusable (angular-comm-2, angular-docs-2). However, hands-on feedback notes Angular's template syntax is not plain HTML/JS but a special dialect (ngFor, structural directives) that tools and JS knowledge don't directly transfer to (angular-comm-3, angular-comm-15), which weakens the 'using what you already know' framing. Missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly showing inline template+style+class co-location, and no independent corroboration that plain HTML/CSS/JS skills fully suffice without learning Angular-specific template syntax.
